name: Apache Kafka source connector for Eventstream
description: Eventstream now offers a fully supported Apache Kafka source connector, letting you bring events from Kafka topics into Microsoft Fabric for real-time analytics. Kafka is widely used for event distribution, and this connector removes the need for custom ingestion code.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream directly to Apache Kafka topics.- Stream Kafka events into Eventhouse, Lakehouse, and other destinations.- Process and route Kafka events with no-code Eventstream operators or SQL operators.
